title: Preexcavation.
officialText:
The use of jetting, augering or other methods of preexcavation shall be subject to the approval of the
commissioner. Where permitted, preexcavation shall be carried out in the same manner as used for piles subject to load tests and
in such a manner that will not impair the carrying capacity of the piles already in place or damage adjacent structures. Pile tips
shall be driven below the preexcavated depth until the required resistance or penetration is obtained.
